description: Oscillator, 3HP — square and pulse only, built around pulse-width modulation

params.text: Sets the pitch, -3 to +6 volts; 0V gives C4 at 261.63Hz
Drops the whole pitch range by seven octaves, so the module runs as an LFO
Sets the pulse width of the output, a 50% square at the 0 mark
Attenuverts the PWM input, and the result is added to the PW knob rather than replacing it

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the frequency knob; the channels patched here set the polyphony
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, over the pulse width, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the PW knob setting
A rising edge hard-syncs the oscillator, restarting its cycle

outputs.text: The square, at the width set by PW and the PWM CV

menu: Linear frequency mode — the frequency follows the pitch voltage at a fixed number of hertz per volt rather than an octave per volt
DC offset correction — on by default, removes the offset the square and pulse waves carry away from a 50% width; turn it off to use such an output as a CV
